profile.headline: Software Engineering Leader
profile.summary:
Driven player/coach software architect with experience managing global teams

Passionate about developing clean and robust code with a heavy focus on performance and efficiency

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Vertex, Inc. provides tax compliance and automation solutions for businesses of all sizes, including over 60% of Fortune 500 companies.

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description:
• Lead architect for the creation of new microservices and 3rd party integrations with partners and internal CRMs such as NetSuite

• Lead biweekly architecture office hours, ARB meetings, and strategic planning discussions of both new solutions and those inherited during acquisitions

• Establish genericized CI/CD pipeline templates for several project types (.NET, PHP, Angular, etc.) especially as it pertains to vulnerability scanning, linting, and code coverage (unit and integration tests)

• Monitor cloud spend and aid in reduction efforts, routinely crafting solutions to solve issues with legacy systems that overused cloud storage and other services
positions.insights: Skills: Containerization · IT Strategy · Microsoft SQL Server · Solution Architecture · Domain-Driven Design (DDD) · Technical Leadership · ElasticSearch · Engineering Management · Linux · NetSuite · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · .NET · Persistence · Project Delivery · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · PostgreSQL · ChatGPT · Blazor · Powershell · Angular · Azure DevOps

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
*Left for a better opportunity after my team was acquired by an organization that did not support remote roles*

Personally identified and led team in resolving software vulnerabilities and compliance issues

Conceptualized and led process improvement initiatives which allowed critical employees to focus on their primary roles
positions.insights: Skills: Leading Development Teams · Technology Leadership · Bitbucket · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon Dynamodb · TypeScript · .NET · .NET Core · Software Architecture

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Managed global development team to create cyber security solutions for the enterprise using a myriad of languages and technologies such as C# (.NET Core 3.1), Python 2/3, Java 11/14, Groovy, Node.js, MSSQL, Postgres, ELK stack, AWS, etc.

• Led data migration and backward-compatibility efforts for initial rollout of connector framework, helping secure $300m investment in Aug. 2020

• Regularly conducted interviews for senior software engineers and other technical positions to build out a rapidly expanding development team across three global locations
positions.insights: Skills: Containerization · IT Strategy · Solution Architecture · JavaScript · .NET Core · Domain-Driven Design (DDD) · Java · Technical Leadership · ElasticSearch · Engineering Management · Linux · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · .NET · Persistence · Project Delivery · Python (Programming Language) · Angular · Azure DevOps

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
•Regularly led global Office Hours meeting for GM employees who need help with both out-of-the-box and highly customized SharePoint sites

•Led team in .NET Core development with an emphasis on pushing new and existing apps to cloud environments; resident SME on Entity Framework Core, performance improvements, and best practices

•Used Elasticsearch, Solr, MSSQL, and a suite of other tools in order to produce a set of fast search APIs to be leveraged by many internal applications; was recruited specifically to help improve performance of both back-end jobs and API response times by optimizing older code

•Developed and supported custom web-based client and server-side applications primarily using .NET Core and JavaScript for internal content management across global verticals such as Finance, Safety, Product Development, Manufacturing, Legal, and IT

•Received early promotion out of College New Hire program

•Created and led subsequent development on .NET application which completes a variety of complex scheduled (via Quartz.NET) tasks in order to process millions of rows of engineering profile data for approval and synchronization with other systems

•Created custom SharePoint sites using html, js, css, and c#; also involved creating custom actions and workflows varying in size and complexity; this includes a task management system which has helped to reduce the total cost of late fines issued by NHTSA from >$30 mil. in 2014 to $0 each year for the next few years

•Migrated 500+ Lotus Notes databases to SharePoint and drove innovation through the use of latest web technologies such as HTML5, REST API, and the provider-hosted app model

•Represented GMIT in university recruiting events by networking with faculty, discussing personal experiences, and assisting in the selection of interview candidates
positions.insights: Skills: Containerization · SharePoint 2013 · Microsoft SQL Server · Solution Architecture · JavaScript · .NET Core · Technical Leadership · Technical Writing · ElasticSearch · Engineering Management · Linux · .NET · Persistence · Project Delivery · Angular · Azure DevOps · Software Architecture

positions.title: S3/Information Technology Specialist I (Intern)
positions.description:
•Monitored DBMS and hosted server solutions for national law enforcement agencies
•Presented new solutions and training demonstrations to upper management
•Assisted in managing the Network Operations Center (NOC)
•Conducted internal project planning for products which were eventually adopted such as SharePoint, Lync, and Office 365
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft SQL Server · JavaScript · Linux · .NET · Persistence

positions.title: Freelance Computer Repair
positions.description:
•Assessed technical issues with computers, mobile devices, and gaming consoles
•Replaced LCD screens, cases, and keyboard keys
•Built unique desktop computers specific to clients' requirements
•Performed data recovery and virus removal

honors.title: teamGM Recognition Award
honors.description: • Developed a SharePoint site and Windows service in order to facilitate the automation of onboarding, editing, and approving user profile information and program access for ~30,000 engineers onto several COTS PLM systems such as Teamcenter and Aras.
honors.issuer: Issued by EDGE User Profile Maintenance Tool Project · Dec 2016

honors.title: teamGM Recognition Award
honors.description:
• Developed and acquired sign off on solution to migrate a critical Lotus Notes database to a SharePoint site collection within 2 weeks without being provided a set of requirements
• Reverse engineered the database using IBM Domino Designer in order to understand the business process via code and construct a SharePoint-compatible data model and UI. The code I dissected was one of many written in a foreign language 😅
honors.issuer: Issued by Global Legal/Type Approval Project · Oct 2015

volunteerExperiences.description: • Signed on to provide mentorship and career shadowing for students who have expressed an interest in the field of cybersecurity

•Donated toys, jackets, and warm outfits specifically for my adoptive children in the Adopt A Child Program (2013, 2015)
•Regularly attend and support fundraisers for local charity groups and events
